entries.failure: Technically valid native/hybrid slides used equal-weight boxes/cards with weak focal hierarchy and dead space.
entries.root_cause: Renderer owned composition decisions and normalized heterogeneous evidence into peer components.
entries.fix: Introduce Visual IR with explicit protagonist, hierarchy, archetype, density, spatial grammar and deck rhythm before coordinates.

entries.failure: Image-first baseline rendered internal semantic/IR labels into presentation pixels.
entries.root_cause: Generated full-slide image was allowed to synthesize both semantics and presentation surface.
entries.fix: Keep semantic text native; generated assets must be bounded and text-free unless source text is explicitly preserved.

entries.failure: First Validation sample passed structural checks but title wrapped into subtitle in the rendered pixels.
entries.root_cause: Geometry-only audit did not model actual rendered text line count and vertical occupation.
entries.fix: Treat structural geometry as necessary but insufficient; require pixel review and conservative text-fit preflight with role-specific floors.

entries.failure: Early Validation refinements were cleaner but still felt like a polished template because proof remained a floating panel/card.
entries.root_cause: Container geometry carried more visual identity than the claim/evidence relationship.
entries.fix: Prefer open/asymmetric fields and edge-anchored composition when containers are not semantically necessary.

entries.failure: Initial How-It-Works composition placed four labels on a long horizontal spine while the product screenshot remained a small lower-right thumbnail, producing dead space and weak product proof.
entries.root_cause: The compiler treated the process as evenly distributed steps instead of honoring the Visual IR requirement that the decision/product be the terminal destination.
entries.fix: Compress early sensing stages into a differentiated signal chain and allocate a dedicated light product-destination field with a larger independently replaceable screenshot.

entries.failure: The deterministic product screenshot fixture contained invented cafeteria wait values that were not present in the frozen benchmark facts.
entries.root_cause: A visual fixture was treated as harmless decoration even though readable UI text can be interpreted as product/evidence content.
entries.fix: Redesign the mock UI around frozen semantic copy only: Wait prediction, Go now / choose another cafeteria, and the known three-cafeteria test context; remove fabricated numeric estimates.

entries.failure: The first three-slide Stage 4 compiler improved visual quality but still dispatched by QueueZero slide ID and embedded concrete asset paths in layout recipes.
entries.root_cause: Benchmark implementation outran the intended architecture boundary between Visual IR, composition grammar and concrete asset realization.
entries.fix: Introduce an archetype+variant solver registry that binds semantic objects by role/hierarchy/group structure, plus a separate benchmark asset-binding layer. Add CI that forbids benchmark slide IDs inside reusable solvers.

entries.failure: The v15 full-deck run failed even though the structural/provenance audit and realization regressions passed, because the text-capacity panic test still caught SystemExit after the shared audit helper was refactored to raise ValueError.
entries.root_cause: Negative regression code depended on the transport-level exception type of a CLI-oriented helper rather than the helper's semantic failure contract.
entries.fix: Keep reusable audit helpers on ValueError and make panic tests assert the semantic failure message while catching ValueError; reserve SystemExit for top-level CLI adapters.
